name: Terms of Mercy
description: Wren and Mara: a settlement read over the whole party. Everyone is mended. Mara starts her next turn a thread short.

name: Breach and Shot
description: Dax and Hale: the hammer takes the shield off and the shot goes through the gap. Ignores shields. Hale starts his next turn a thread short.

name: Cross-Reference
description: The Auditor and ILO-9: every enemy on the field is Marked at once, weaknesses and all. ILO-9 starts its next turn a thread short.

name: Testimony
description: The Auditor and Wren: the whole party is Anchored for two turns. Nobody drops below 1 Resolve. Wren starts her next turn a thread short.

name: Precedent
description: Mara and ILO-9: a ruling with the machine's citations behind it. Every enemy is Bound by terms. ILO-9 starts its next turn a thread short.

name: Teardown Crew
description: Dax and Quiroga: she finds the seam and he opens it. Ignores shields. Quiroga starts her next turn a thread short.

name: Held Ledger
description: Hale and young Strand: a shot fired down the length of the ledger. Chronal, ignores armor. Strand starts his next turn a thread short.
